picks.title: Wonderful more than doubles its valuation to $5B in under 6 months
picks.why_it_matters: A $550M Series C at a $5B valuation in under 6 months signals aggressive investor appetite for FDE (likely full-stack dev/engineering) tooling—early-stage VCs should watch this category for adjacent opportunities and potential acqui-hire exits.

picks.title: Palo Alto Networks paid $500M for Thrive-backed Console, sources say
picks.why_it_matters: A $500M exit in AI IT service automation validates the category and clears the field for Serval as the remaining leader—creating a potential Series A/B opportunity or signaling consolidation plays for early-stage competitors.

picks.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
picks.why_it_matters: A dedicated 'Cyber' variant from Google signals foundation model providers are unbundling for verticals—early-stage startups building on commodity models need to reassess differentiation as incumbents move into specialized use cases.
